subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orcahealth.com>, Diego Morales <diego.m@orcahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-17T09:02:00Z
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing

Hi Samantha / Diego —

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a focused renewal/expansion plan for Orca Health so we can lock term options, confirm a baseline capacity uplift, and schedule a short QBR to align execs and engineering. High level:

- Goal: Renew current contract with a staged capacity uplift of +40% over the next 12 months and an optional seat uplift for the clinical inference pipeline.
- Timeline proposal: mutual action plan (MAP) finalized by May 3; contract issued by May 17; QBR week of May 27.
- Owners: Redwood (Maya + Ben for technical ops; Jonas for pricing/workflow), Orca (Samantha for product, Diego for infra).

Action items I’m proposing for this thread:
1) Samantha / Diego — confirm the primary QBR attendee list and two preferred week-of-May timeslots.
2) Procurement — if you want us to route an early-term draft to legal ahead of the MAP signoff, please indicate.
3) Ben / Jonas / Monica — draft capacity profile and run-rate estimate for +40% uplift, include any hardware/latency constraints.

I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (ORCA_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx) and a simple QBR poll calendar (.ics) with three slot options. I’ll circulate an updated MAP after we get your availability and the capacity numbers from Ben.

Thanks — aiming for a short, operational QBR rather than a long executive deck. Let me know if Orca prefers otherwise.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
maya@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: ORCA_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
Attachment: QBR_slot_options.ics (calendar poll)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@orcahealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diego Morales <diego.m@orcahealth.com>, Procurement <procure@orcahealth.com>
Date: 2029-04-17T13:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing

Maya —

Thanks for the clear plan and attachments. We're aligned on intent and appreciate the compact timeline. Quick responses below:

- QBR attendees: Myself (Head of Product), Diego (Director of Infrastructure), CFO (TBD), and our Head of Clinical Ops (Anita Rao).
- Preferred QBR windows: week of May 27 — Tue morning (May 28 09:00–10:30 PT) or Wed afternoon (May 29 15:00–16:30 PT). Either works.
- Procurement: I’ve looped in our procurement alias (procure@orcahealth.com). They will confirm whether they want to see a term draft now or after MAP signoff.

Two asks from Orca: 1) can we get a one-page summary showing how the +40% capacity maps to cost and expected response-time SLO impacts; 2) we need a short staffing plan that indicates what Redwood will own vs Orca for the pilot period.

If you can update the MAP with a staffing row and an estimated cost table, we should be able to move quickly.

Best,
Samantha Lee
VP Product, Orca Health
samantha@orcahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T10:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing

Maya / team —

Quick run with the infra numbers for Orca's +40% uplift. Summary below — I’ll drop a short table into the MAP v1 and flag any caveats.

- Current baseline: 12 GPU-hours avg/day; 95th p99 latency 180ms for clinical models.
- +40% uplift projection: 16.8 GPU-hours avg/day (we’ll round to a committed 17 GPU-hours/day for packaging).
- Cost/Run-rate: incremental commit adds ~ $12,400/month at current pricing, estimated effective unit cost reduces ~6% because of batching efficiency at higher throughput.
- SLO impact: with modest autoscale headroom we expect p99 to remain > 200ms only during sustained bursts above 2x baseline; recommend a small reserved burst pool (2 GPUs) for critical pipelines.

Staffing suggestions (for the MAP staffing row):
- Redwood: Primary technical owner (Ben) + 0.2 FTE Solutions Engineer during onboarding; 0.1 FTE ongoing TAM time for operational runbooks.
- Orca: Primary infra lead (Diego) for network/KMS access; Product owner (Samantha) for feature prioritization; Clinical Ops for validation.

I’ll attach the draft MAP update in a separate note and tag Jonas for pricing finalization.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: ORCA_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (updated: capacity & staffing row)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orcahealth.com>, Diego Morales <diego.m@orcahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T12:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing

Samantha —

Thanks — that timing works. Per Ben’s numbers below I’ve updated the MAP with a staffing row and a one-page cost summary. I’ve attached the revised ORCA_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx and re-sent the QBR_slot_options.ics with Tue 09:00 PT and Wed 15:00 PT selected as primary candidates.

Next steps (short):
- Samantha / Diego: confirm which QBR slot you prefer (Tue 09:00 PT or Wed 15:00 PT) and the attendee list for invites.
- Procurement: flag whether you want an early-term draft to review (we can route an internal draft to legal next Wednesday).
- Redwood ops: Ben to prepare a 15-min technical runbook and Monica to prepare a one-slide onboarding checklist. Jonas to finalize the pricing line.

I’ll hold on calendar until we get your preferred slot and will send meeting invites to all confirmed attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to a short, practical QBR.

Best,
Maya

Attachment: ORCA_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (updated: staffing & cost summary)
Attachment: QBR_slot_options.ics (updated selection)
From: Diego Morales <diego.m@orcahealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@orcahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@orcahealth.com>
Date: 2029-04-18T15:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift, staffing, and QBR timing

Maya / Samantha —

We’ll take Tue May 28 09:00 PT for the QBR and include our Head of Clinical Ops and one engineer from SRE. Procurement will confirm whether they want the draft legal now — I expect they’ll wait until MAP signoff but they’ll tell us by EOD tomorrow.

One additional ask: can Redwood include a short security checklist (network/KMS/retention points) as an appendix in the MAP so our SRE has an early read? Otherwise we’ll ask for a brief pre-QBR sync.

Diego
Director of Infrastructure, Orca Health
diego.m@orcahealth.com
